probing_questions: Identify answerable questions about rival mechanisms, constraints, policy choices, assumptions, affected interests and discriminating evidence. Do not presume a position, balance or exhaustive representation. Use the supplied institutional population independently of any optional later comparison target.

Give 12–24 distinct literal search phrases, including mechanisms, actor identities, institutions, qualifications and contrary outcomes. These route windows within EVERY selected institutional text, not a selection of agreeable texts. No Boolean operators.

For follow_up, identify the supplied prior memo's conclusions and uncertainties with its real job/source identity and concrete passages; mark truncated or unavailable baseline context. For standalone, formulate a provisional research question without inventing a prior investigation.

problematique: Investigate the supplied question through institutional originals without requiring a target thinker. Reconstruct arguments, mechanisms, constraints, interventions and disagreement from the actual documents and voices. Keep adoption, signed views, guest contributions and participant statements distinct. Prior maps are retained analysis; only original passages support new source claims. Describe the considered, searched, acquired and actually read population separately, including geographic, language and publication-date coverage. Search misses and unavailable originals cannot establish institutional silence. Group by institution without manufacturing consensus from internal disagreement, syndicated copies or several formats of one event. Preserve evidence identities, exact quotations and native page/time loci. Never invent missing originals, authority, dates, transcripts or positions. Treat question premises and causal inferences as hypotheses. If validation_errors and previous_draft are supplied, return a complete corrected answer supported by the same evidence; preserve uncertainty instead of manufacturing support.
